name: Exp_ForexLine
summary: This EA trades based on the custom ForexLine indicator, which uses dual smoothed moving average lines to detect trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. Position management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms library, supporting multiple money management modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义ForexLine指标进行交易，该指标使用双平滑移动平均线检测趋势方向。当指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号时开空仓，支持可配置的止损和止盈。仓位管理委托给TradeAlgorithms库，支持多种资金管理模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ForexLine自定义指标的趋势跟踪，该指标通过两条经过双重平滑处理的移动平均线来判断市场趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值从非零切换到0且缓冲区0大于0时开多仓，当缓冲区1值为2且缓冲区0小于2时开空仓。出场条件为：当趋势反转信号出现时分别平掉多头或空头仓位，同时使用固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）进行风险管理。仓位管理支持五种模式，包括按自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的自由保证金、扣除亏损后的余额以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保仅在新的K线形成时才检测信号，避免重复入场，同时提供了SignalBar参数允许在当前K线上实时检测信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend following using the custom ForexLine indicator, which employs two doubly-smoothed moving average lines to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 transitions to 0 and buffer 0 is greater than 0, while a sell signal occurs when buffer 1 equals 2 and buffer 0 is less than 2. Exit conditions include closing buy positions when a downtrend signal appears and closing sell positions when an uptrend signal appears, combined with fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) levels for risk management. Position sizing supports five modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The strategy uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal detection only occurs on new bar formation, preventing duplicate entries, while also providing a SignalBar parameter that allows real-time signal detection on the current bar when set to 0.

pros: 支持10种平滑算法（SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX/T3等），灵活度高
提供5种资金管理模式和4个独立的开平仓开关，风控参数丰富
使用IsNewBar机制防止重复信号，逻辑严谨
双重平滑处理减少了假信号，提高信号可靠性
默认使用H8周期，适合中长线趋势跟踪，避免噪音干扰
pros_en: Supports 10 smoothing algorithms (SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX/T3 etc.), offering high flexibility
Provides 5 money management modes and 4 independent open/close switches for granular risk control
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate signals, ensuring robust logic
Double smoothing reduces false signals and improves signal reliability
Default H8 timeframe suits medium-to-long-term trend following, avoiding market noise
cons: 高度依赖外部自定义指标ForexLine和两个Include库，独立运行困难
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，在非大周期环境下风险极高
缺少点差过滤和最大持仓检查，在剧烈行情中可能连续开仓
指标信号逻辑不够透明，仅通过缓冲区数值判断趋势方向，难以验证
没有追踪止损或移动止盈机制，无法在趋势中锁定浮动利润
cons_en: Heavily depends on external custom indicator ForexLine and two Include libraries, making standalone operation difficult
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, posing high risk on smaller timeframes
Lacks spread filter and maximum position checks, potentially leading to consecutive entries during volatile markets
Indicator signal logic is opaque, relying solely on buffer values to determine trend direction, making verification difficult
No trailing stop or dynamic take profit mechanism, unable to lock in floating profits during trending moves
improvements: 增加点差过滤和最大同时持仓数量限制，降低极端行情下的风险敞口
添加追踪止损或动态止盈功能，在趋势延续时保护浮动利润
improvements_en: Add spread filter and maximum concurrent position limits to reduce risk exposure during extreme market conditions
Implement trailing stop or dynamic take profit functionality to protect floating profits during trend continuation

risk_points: 默认止损止盈点数非常大（1000/2000点），若参数未适当调整可能导致单笔巨额亏损
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大时可能以不利价格入场
依赖外部自定义指标文件，若指标缺失EA将无法初始化
risk_points_en: Default SL/TP values are very large (1000/2000 points), potentially causing significant single-trade losses if parameters are not properly adjusted
No spread filter, potentially entering at unfavorable prices during high-spread conditions
Depends on external custom indicator file; EA fails to initialize if the indicator is missing
